name: pr-review-gate
description: Collect pull request details via form, gate on reviewer approval or rejection, then emit a formal review record.

steps.description: Reviewer must approve or reject the PR before the record is written.
steps.prompt: Review the pull request details collected in the previous step. Approve to record an approved review, or reject to record a rejection.

steps.description: Emit the formal PR review record.
steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  "## PR Review Record\n" +
  "**Title:** " + ((."collect-pr".title // "(untitled)") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Author:** " + ((."collect-pr".author // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Risk:** " + ((."collect-pr".risk // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Reviewer (self-reported):** " + ((.inputs.reviewer // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Decision:** " + ((."gate-review".decision // "?") | tostring) +
  (if ((."collect-pr".url // "") | tostring) != "" then
    "\n**URL:** " + ((."collect-pr".url // "") | tostring)
  else "" end) +
  "\n\n_Unauthenticated local record: OpenSOP does not verify approver identity — the actor is whoever ran this process (same trust boundary as a Makefile)._"
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{review_record: .}'
